user.title: Set up Climate Sleep Curve
user.description: Create the integration container. Curves and controllers are configured from the card. The integration never turns a climate device on or off.

start.name: Start sleep curve
start.description: Start a session without turning on the climate device.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional profile override for this session.

stop.name: Stop sleep curve
stop.description: Stop the active session without turning off the climate device.

apply_current_point.name: Apply current point
apply_current_point.description: Apply the current target only when the climate device is already running.

controller_id.name: Controller ID
controller_id.description: Controller whose point should be applied.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload storage and schedules without controlling climate devices.
